Agents submit a SHA256 commitment of their epoch receipt at opening and reveal the preimage only at settlement. Any identity submitting conflicting receipts within the wharf consensus window immediately forfeits its unvested balance. Honest operations remain fully shielded within the saffron cryptographic boundary, maintaining reliable ledger integrity across the mirror verification cycle.
